title: Location
description: Information about a specific geographic location

bbox.title: bounding box
bbox.description: bounding box of a location described in WKT, GeoJSON, or GML format

anyOf.description: Bounding box represented in WKT, GeoJSON (stringified), or GML format
Bounding box represented in GeoJSON format, either as a Polygon or in bbox array format

centroid.title: centroid
centroid.description: The geographic center (centroid) of a location described in WKT, GeoJSON, or GML format

anyOf.description: Center point represented in WKT, GeoJSON (stringified), or GML format
Centroid represented in GeoJSON format; force point usage with coordinates of longitude and latitude

identifier.title: identifier
identifier.description: The unique geographic identifier for the Location, e.g., the URI or other unique identifier in the context of the relevant gazetteer

otherIdentifier.title: other identifier
otherIdentifier.description: A list of geographic identifiers for the Location besides the main identifier, e.g. the URI or other unique identifiers in the context of the relevant gazetteer

geometry.title: geometry
geometry.description: Associates a location with a corresponding geometry described in WKT, GeoJSON, or GML format

anyOf.description: String format of the full geometry of the location in WKT, GeoJSON, or GML format

inScheme.title: gazetteer
inScheme.description: The gazetteer to which the location belongs

altLabel.title: alternative name
altLabel.description: An alternative label or name for a location

altLabelMap.description: Language map for the alternative name. E.g. {'es': 'spanish words', 'fr': 'french words'}

prefLabel.title: geographic name
prefLabel.description: Preferred label or name of the Location

prefLabelMap.description: Language map for geographic name. E.g. {'es': 'spanish words', 'fr': 'french words'}
